about: Test set 3. Written on 5 November 2026 before the third round of search changes, and not used to tune them (tuning used bench/tasks.json and bench/holdout-tasks.json). A larger mix: long notes, tables, a superseded fact for some questions (an older note says something different; the answer is the current value), an unrelated side project as a distractor, 10 questions worded differently from the notes (paraphrase=true) and 2 with no answer. All notes are fake, see bench/test3-vault/.

arguments.title: Twilio retry queue
arguments.content: Added the retry queue for emergency texts: failed sends retry every 2 minutes for up to 30 minutes, then the app shows the hiker that the text could not be sent. Tested with the three verified test numbers only.
